name: Lyo.Nfc.Pcsc
tagline: PC/SC driver for Type 2 NFC pages.
description: `AddPcscNfc` registers `PcscNfcReader` as `INfcReader`. Connect with a reader name, or null to use the first reader. On Linux install and start `pcscd` (`libpcsclite`). The APDUs are the ACR122U Type 2 set: GET UID `FF CA 00 00 00`, read four pages `FF B0 00 page 10`, write one page `FF D6 00 page 04` plus four data bytes. This driver does not speak ISO 15693, so it cannot see a Tonie figure.
features: **Registration.** `services.AddPcscNfc()` adds a singleton `INfcReader`. There is no options type.
**Linux.** The PC/SC service must be running (`pcscd`). Tests do not open a reader; they lock the APDU bytes.
